title: About Us
body:
About Yadea
Yadea, the world's leading electric two-wheeler brand, has ranked global No.1 in annual sales for the last 8 consecutive years, with product ranges mainly covering high-performance electric motorcycles, electric mopeds, electric bicycles, and electric kick scooters, and is officially distributed by Eiffel Industries Ltd.
Our wish
Increase Yadea's leadership role in the industry, by creating a new generation that’s identified by a green commuting lifestyle.
Our mission
Master the innovation and core technology of electric vehicles, abide by the international safety/quality standards and provide the world with superior solutions for electric mobility.
Our promise
Provide a convenient, safe, free and comfortable ultimate riding experience for our customers.

body:
Terms & Conditions
Welcome to Yadea Pakistan . This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you interact with our website, www.yadea.com.pk , or engage with our services.
1. Information We Collect
a. Personal Information
We may collect and store the following:
Your name, email, and phone number
Billing and shipping address
Payment information (handled securely via third-party providers)
Purchase history and order details
b. Technical and Usage Information
IP address
Browser type and device information
Pages visited on our website
Cookies and tracking data
2. How We Use Your Information
We use the information to:
Process your orders and deliver electric bikes or accessories
Respond to your customer support inquiries
Send promotional emails and product updates (if you've opted in)
Improve website performance and customer experience
Meet legal and regulatory obligations
3. Sharing of Information
We do not sell your data. However, your information may be shared with:
Trusted partners , such as delivery services and payment processors
Legal authorities , if required by law
Marketing service providers , only if you have given explicit consent
4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Understand user behavior on our website
Save your preferences for future visits
Enable cart functionality and secure logins
You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not function correctly.
5. Your Data Protection Rights
You have the right to:
Request access to the personal data we hold
Request correction or deletion of your information
Opt out of direct marketing at any time
To request any of the above, email us at hello@yadea.com.pk .

We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal data. However, no online platform is 100% secure, and we recommend exercising caution when sharing information online.

Our website may link to external sites. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those websites.

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

title: Refund and Returns Policy
body:
Refund and Returns Policy
Overview
Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can't offer you a full refund or exchange.
To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.
Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.
Additional non-returnable items:
Gift cards
Downloadable software products
Some health and personal care items
To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.
Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer. For guidance on your purchase, you can contact Yadea Pakistan or visit an authorized Yadea dealer .
There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:
Book with obvious signs of use
CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened
Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error
Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery
Refunds
Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.
If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.
Late or Missing Refunds
If you haven't received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.
Then contact your credit card company, as it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.
Next, contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted. You can also find consumer guidance on the State Bank of Pakistan website .
If you've done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at hello@yadea.com.pk or call our UAN 021-111-300-375.
Exchanges
We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at hello@yadea.com.pk and send your item to: [Physical Address].
For warranty-related concerns, please visit our Service Support page, or see Product Support for help with your product.
Gifts
If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you'll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.
If the item wasn't marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.
Shipping Returns
To return your product, you should mail your product to: [Physical Address].
You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.
Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.
If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service such as TCS or Pakistan Post , or purchasing shipping insurance. We don't guarantee that we will receive your returned item.
Need Help?
Contact us at hello@yadea.com.pk for questions related to refunds and returns. You can also reach us through our Contact Us page. To learn how we handle your information, read our Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions .
